WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT
    ili.order_item_id,
    p.product_color,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  INNER JOIN Order_Items AS oi
    ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN Products AS p
    ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_quantity,
    avg_cost_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY product_color
      ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC
    ) AS rank_in_color
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_quantity,
  avg_cost_ratio,
  rank_in_color
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_in_color <= 3;
